_comment: Quest log, decided by the authority (SimAuthority quest_event). Generated by server/tools/gen_quests.py - edit the table there and re-run. Two quests per level 1-50. A quest is open once the player reached its `level` and claimed every quest in `requires`; open quests accumulate and progress independently. A finished quest waits in `ready` until the player claims it (sim_quest_claim), which pays the reward. Types: talk (target = NPC name, within talk_radius), kill (target = mob species from its scene; `boss` counts only boss kills), dummy (hits on a training dummy), equip (target = equipment slot), refine (a successful refinement), enchant (a successful imbue), monolith, dungeon (target = dungeons.json id, the run completes), enter_map (target = map id), visit (target = a place below; `mounted` requires the broom). Rewards: reward_exp (a share of the level's experience threshold by size), reward_gold, reward_house_rep, reward_items [{id, amount}] (bag, or a personal chest at the player's feet when it is full). Progress persists in the character's `quests` object (progress, ready, done).

chapters.title: First Year
chapters.desc: Settle in at Kaf Castle, raised over the shard of the fallen World-Star Ithrel: your cloak, your first spells, your first broom.

chapters.title: The Forest Edge
chapters.desc: Darkened shards fall into the Raven Woods and the creatures grow bolder; learn the forge and the trial.

chapters.title: Roads to Orvell
chapters.desc: Bandits prowl the roads; the village needs a wand it can trust.

chapters.title: Crypts and Trolls
chapters.desc: The dead stir in the crypts, the trolls come down from their hollow - and an old name turns up in the records: the Ash Priest.

chapters.title: Barrows and Webs
chapters.desc: The dead rise in the barrows; deep in the caverns the Web Mother broods on a shard the Ash Priest gave her.

chapters.title: The Moors
chapters.desc: Trolls and the Ash Priest's dark wizards hold the moors above Orvell.

chapters.title: The Sealed Wing
chapters.desc: The castle's sealed wing hides a piece of an old gate to another realm - and something guards it.

chapters.title: Stone and Storm
chapters.desc: Mountain trolls gather under Grak around a Dark Shard on the Stone Circle Summit.

chapters.title: The Long Mist
chapters.desc: The mist of Morhal rolls in from the shore and the Pallids with it; only the Light of Ithrel will hold them back.

chain.title: First-Year Orientation
chain.name: Speak with Master Teral Venn by the fountain
chain.desc: Master Teral Venn waits beside the courtyard fountain (the bobbing gold arrow). Walk up and click him or press F to talk.

chain.title: Dressed for the Grounds
chain.name: Wear the Woolen Traveller's Cloak
chain.desc: Open your bag with I and right-click the cloak Master Teral Venn gave you. It costs a little speed and buys a lot of armour.

chain.title: Wand Drills
chain.name: Hit a training dummy 5 times
chain.desc: Three training dummies stand by the east road, just outside the courtyard wall - they never hit back. Left-click to cast; spells hurt nothing inside the safe courtyard.

chain.title: Spiders at the Gate
chain.name: Defeat 6 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Leave the courtyard for the Village Outskirts or the Pitch Outskirts. Hit one spider and its pack answers - keep moving.

chain.title: Restless Dead
chain.name: Defeat 6 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: Drowned Ones stalk the Forest Edge past Borin's hut. Fire (Flame Wave) hurts them twice as much.

chain.title: Borin's Hut
chain.name: Report to Borin at his hut
chain.desc: Borin Ashgrove, the forest warden, keeps watch from his hut west of the castle.

chain.title: Thinning the Brood
chain.name: Defeat 10 Black Weavers
chain.desc: The spiders breed faster than anyone can count. Greenhouse Meadow is crawling with them.

chain.title: Through the Great Doors
chain.name: Enter Kaf Castle
chain.desc: Walk up the castle approach and press F in the doorway to go inside.

chain.title: Your First Broom
chain.name: Collect your broom from Flight Master Kaelen Rook
chain.desc: At level 5 every student gets a broom. Flight Master Kaelen Rook waits at the castle approach.

chain.title: Skyring Tryouts
chain.name: Fly to the Skyring Pitch on your broom
chain.desc: Equip the broom, press Shift to mount, Space to rise and Ctrl to descend. Land on level ground and press Shift to dismount.

chain.title: Ash and Bone
chain.name: Defeat 12 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: The Drowned Ones gather again at the Forest Edge and in Greenhouse Meadow.

chain.title: Kestrin's Forge
chain.name: Speak with Kestrin
chain.desc: Kestrin works his anvil in the courtyard. He can make a wand stronger, at a price.

chain.title: A Stronger Wand
chain.name: Refine your wand once at Kestrin
chain.desc: Press O to open Kestrin's workshop, drag your wand onto the anvil and refine it with Velkar Ash and Oril.

chain.title: The Eastern Road
chain.name: Defeat 12 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Merchants on the Eastern Road are turning back. Clear the spiders from the verges.

chain.title: Woven Magic
chain.name: Enchant an item at Kestrin
chain.desc: Put any piece of gear on the anvil and use an Imbue Scroll. A failed weave still spends the scroll.

chain.title: The Long Road Home
chain.name: Defeat 14 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: Drowned Ones wander onto the Eastern Road at dusk. Keep the road open.

chain.title: Weaver Thicket
chain.name: Defeat 16 Black Weavers
chain.desc: West of the forest edge the spiders grow to the size of carts. Bring potions.

chain.title: Shatter the Darkness
chain.name: Help destroy a Dark Shard
chain.desc: The Ash Priest drags darkened star shards out of the Void and they fall in the western forests: at the Forest Edge past Borin's hut, in the Weaver Thicket beyond it, in Bandit Woods to the north-west and in Crypt Hollow far to the west. Close by, a green light rises over the trees. Break one with others before its waves overrun you.

chain.title: The Trial Hall
chain.name: Complete the Trial Hall
chain.desc: The Trial Hall portal is the glowing arch on the courtyard lawn, beside the lake walk. Step into it and press F, clear the corridor, then defeat the Trial Warden. Up to five can go in together.

chain.title: A Wand Worth Keeping
chain.name: Equip the Runebound Walnut Wand
chain.desc: Your new wand rolls a far higher Attack and Magic Attack Value. Equip it from your bag.

chain.title: Bandits on the Road
chain.name: Defeat 10 Bandits
chain.desc: Bandits waylay travellers on the Orvell Road. They cast back - keep your distance.

chain.title: The Red Lantern
chain.name: Speak with Bessa Tull in Orvell
chain.desc: Fly east along the Orvell Road. Bessa Tull knows every rumour in the valley.

chain.title: Pitch Woods
chain.name: Defeat 15 Black Weavers
chain.desc: The woods behind the Skyring Pitch are thick with webs.

chain.title: Lakeside Glade
chain.name: Defeat 15 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: Drowned Ones crawl out of Lake Lunra at the Lakeside Glade.

chain.title: Bandit Woods
chain.name: Defeat 14 Bandits
chain.desc: The bandits have a camp in the woods north-west of the castle. Drive them out.

chain.title: Survey the Lake
chain.name: Visit the Lakeside Glade
chain.desc: Borin wants to know how far the Drowned Ones have spread along the shore.

chain.title: Webs in the Glade
chain.name: Defeat 18 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Spiders and dead share the Lakeside Glade now. Clear the spiders first.

chain.title: Steel for the Road
chain.name: Refine any item twice
chain.desc: Kestrin can refine cloaks, accessories and brooms as well as wands.

chain.title: Breaking the Ring
chain.name: Defeat 18 Bandits
chain.desc: Bessa has heard the bandits answer to a captain. Weaken them before he moves.

chain.title: Crypt Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 18 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: Deeper in the forest an old crypt has opened. The Drowned Ones pour out of Crypt Hollow.

chain.title: Records of the Crypt
chain.name: Speak with Archivist Emrel Sav
chain.desc: Archivist Emrel Sav keeps the records of every grave in the valley - and one old entry names the Ash Priest, who once tried to open the gate of Morhal. She waits at the castle approach.

chain.title: Troll Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 6 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Forest trolls hit hard and slowly. Watch for the slam and step out of it.

chain.title: Sealing the Crypt
chain.name: Defeat 20 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: Keep the Drowned Ones in Crypt Hollow from reaching the forest paths.

chain.title: Dark Thicket
chain.name: Defeat 16 Bandits
chain.desc: The bandits fell back into the Dark Thicket, far to the west.

chain.title: Hollow Drums
chain.name: Defeat 10 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: The trolls beat drums every night. Silence them.

chain.title: Spider Woods
chain.name: Defeat 20 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Larger spiders hunt in the Spider Woods; something is feeding them.

chain.title: The Southern Barrows
chain.name: Defeat 22 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: The barrows south of the lake have broken open.

chain.title: The Smugglers' Camp
chain.name: Scout the Smugglers' Camp
chain.desc: Find the bandit captain's camp deep in the northern woods, past Bandit Woods. Do not engage alone.

chain.title: The Bandit Chief
chain.name: Defeat the captain at the Smugglers' Camp
chain.desc: Gather friends and defeat the Bandit Chief in his camp.

chain.title: Last of the Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 10 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Without the bandits' coin the trolls of the hollow will scatter. Finish them.

chain.title: Ridge Path
chain.name: Defeat 20 Bandits
chain.desc: The captain's men fled up the Ridge Path. Hunt them down.

chain.title: Barrow Watch
chain.name: Defeat 24 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: Hold the Southern Barrows while Archivist Emrel Sav searches her records.

chain.title: Brood of the Woods
chain.name: Defeat 22 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Every spider in the Spider Woods answers to one mother.

chain.title: Crypt Gate
chain.name: Defeat 24 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: The Crypt Gate to the west is the source. Thin the dead around it.

chain.title: Weaving for War
chain.name: Enchant items twice
chain.desc: Kestrin says no one should face the Black Widow with bare robes.

chain.title: Ridge Ambush
chain.name: Defeat 22 Bandits
chain.desc: The bandits ambush anyone who climbs the Ridge Path.

chain.title: The Black Widow's Guard
chain.name: Defeat 26 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Clear the spiders that guard the way to Spider Hollow.

chain.title: Spider Hollow
chain.name: Find Spider Hollow
chain.desc: The Black Widow nests in Spider Hollow in the far south-west, beyond the Spider Woods.

chain.title: The Black Widow
chain.name: Defeat the Black Widow
chain.desc: Bring a party. The Black Widow's bite poisons and her brood answers her call.

chain.title: Gate of Bones
chain.name: Defeat 26 Drowned Ones
chain.desc: With the Black Widow gone, Archivist Emrel Sav can finally seal the Crypt Gate.

chain.title: The Forge's Fire
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: The moors are harder still. Kestrin will not let you go up there half-made.

chain.title: Western Moor
chain.name: Defeat 12 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Forest trolls have climbed onto the Western Moor.

chain.title: Moorland Orders
chain.name: Speak with Flight Master Kaelen Rook
chain.desc: Kaelen Rook is organising the students who go up to the moors.

chain.title: Trolls on the Heath
chain.name: Defeat 12 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Push the forest trolls off the Western Moor.

chain.title: Orvell Heights
chain.name: Defeat 22 Bandits
chain.desc: The heights above Orvell are crawling with dark wizards.

chain.title: Watchers on the Heights
chain.name: Defeat 24 Bandits
chain.desc: They are watching the village. Make them stop.

chain.title: Clearing the Heights
chain.name: Defeat 26 Bandits
chain.desc: One last push and Orvell can sleep again.

chain.title: The Highland Moor
chain.name: Reach the Highland Moor
chain.desc: Mountain trolls have been seen on the Highland Moor, north of the pitch.

chain.title: Mountain Trolls
chain.name: Defeat 8 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Mountain trolls throw boulders as well as fists. Keep moving.

chain.title: Boulder Throwers
chain.name: Defeat 10 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Every troll you fell is one less marching on the castle.

chain.title: Out of Bounds
chain.name: Speak with Archivist Emrel Sav about the sealed wing
chain.desc: Archivist Emrel Sav has found a note: the sealed wing hides a piece of an old gate to another realm - and it is guarded.

chain.title: Pests of the Sealed Wing
chain.name: Defeat 8 Fidgetlings
chain.desc: Enter the Sealed Wing from the castle. The fidgetlings swarm and lift you off your feet.

chain.title: Living Armour
chain.name: Defeat 6 Suits of Armour
chain.desc: Enchanted suits of armour guard the corridor. Force spells shake them apart.

chain.title: The Cursed Commander
chain.name: Defeat the Cursed Commander
chain.desc: The commander of the armour stands at the corridor's first gate.

chain.title: Strangling Vine
chain.name: Burn the root of the Strangling Vine
chain.desc: Fire is the answer. Burn the vines, then the root.

chain.title: More Fidgetlings
chain.name: Defeat 10 Fidgetlings
chain.desc: The fidgetlings on the stairs beyond the snare are worse than the first lot.

chain.title: Threehead
chain.name: Defeat Threehead
chain.desc: Ring the sleep chime to lull the heads, then strike while they doze.

chain.title: The Corridor Cleared
chain.name: Complete the Sealed Wing
chain.desc: Run the corridor from the fidgetlings to the stone hatch in one go.

chain.title: A Wand for the Storm
chain.name: Speak with Kestrin
chain.desc: Kestrin has finished a wand worthy of what comes next.

chain.title: Eastern Moor
chain.name: Defeat 12 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Grak's trolls hold the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: Grak's Allies
chain.name: Defeat 26 Bandits
chain.desc: Dark wizards march with the trolls on the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: The Troll Muster
chain.name: Defeat 14 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Break the muster before it reaches the summit.

chain.title: Storm Riders
chain.name: Defeat 28 Bandits
chain.desc: The dark wizards ride the storm clouds over the moor.

chain.title: Velkar Weave
chain.name: Enchant items three times
chain.desc: A Velkar Regalia deserves its weave. Make the most of it.

chain.title: Stone Circle Summit
chain.name: Climb to the Stone Circle Summit
chain.desc: Grak, the Mountain Troll Chieftain, waits at the summit, where his clans worship a fallen Dark Shard.

chain.title: Grak the Chieftain
chain.name: Defeat Grak, Mountain Troll Chieftain
chain.desc: Grak only appears every so often. Gather a party and be ready.

chain.title: Scattering the Clans
chain.name: Defeat 16 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Without their chieftain the clans fight among themselves. Finish them.

chain.title: Deserters
chain.name: Defeat 28 Bandits
chain.desc: The dark wizards who marched with Grak are fleeing across the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: Stones Still Standing
chain.name: Destroy a Dark Shard or a Webbound Seal Stone
chain.desc: Grak is gone, but the Ash Priest keeps pulling shards down. Break a Dark Shard in the western forests or a Webbound Seal Stone in the Blackweb Caverns, with others.

chain.title: Masterwork
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: Pallids are coming. Kestrin wants every piece you own at its best.

chain.title: Light of Ithrel
chain.name: Speak with Master Teral Venn about the Light of Ithrel
chain.desc: Master Teral Venn says Pallids fear nothing but the Light of Ithrel, a guardian spirit drawn from the World-Star's light. Learn it in your spell book (V) - it opens at level 40.

chain.title: The Misty Shore
chain.name: Defeat 10 Pallids
chain.desc: Pallids drift in from the Misty Shore. Their aura stops your health from recovering.

chain.title: Station Mist
chain.name: Defeat 12 Pallids
chain.desc: The old station is lost in the mist.

chain.title: Cold Platform
chain.name: Defeat 12 more Pallids
chain.desc: Hold the platform until the mist lifts.

chain.title: Shoreline Vigil
chain.name: Defeat 14 Pallids
chain.desc: Keep the Misty Shore clear for the boats.

chain.title: Warmth Against the Cold
chain.name: Enchant items three times
chain.desc: Kestrin has a theory about weaves that resist despair.

chain.title: Fog Barrens
chain.name: Defeat 14 Pallids
chain.desc: South of the castle the Fog Barrens have swallowed the road.

chain.title: Into the Fog
chain.name: Reach the Fog Barrens
chain.desc: Mark the edge of the fog so the others can follow.

chain.title: Shades of the Barrens
chain.name: Defeat 16 Pallids
chain.desc: The deeper you go, the colder it gets.

chain.title: Lights in the Fog
chain.name: Defeat 16 more Pallids
chain.desc: Every Light of Ithrel you cast lights the way for someone else.

chain.title: Grey Marsh
chain.name: Defeat 16 Pallids
chain.desc: The Grey Marsh is where the mist begins.

chain.title: The Last Polish
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: Kestrin wants one more look at your gear before the end.

chain.title: Marsh Wardens
chain.name: Defeat 18 Pallids
chain.desc: Pallids circle a barrow at the far end of the marsh.

chain.title: Breaking the Circle
chain.name: Defeat 18 more Pallids
chain.desc: Break their circle and the barrow is exposed.

chain.title: The Cold Heart
chain.name: Defeat 20 Pallids
chain.desc: Something at the heart of the marsh calls them.

chain.title: Warden's Barrow
chain.name: Find Warden's Barrow
chain.desc: The Morhal Warden sleeps in a barrow in the marsh.

chain.title: Before the Storm
chain.name: Defeat 22 Pallids
chain.desc: Clear the way to the barrow for your party.

chain.title: Final Preparations
chain.name: Speak with Master Teral Venn
chain.desc: Master Teral Venn has one last piece of advice before you face the Warden of Morhal, the jailer the Ash Priest turned to his side.

chain.title: The Morhal Warden
chain.name: Defeat the Morhal Warden
chain.desc: Gather your strongest friends. The Warden drains hope itself.

chain.title: Graduation
chain.name: Report your victory to Master Teral Venn
chain.desc: The valley is safe - for now. The Ash Priest has fled through a rift into another realm. Master Teral Venn is waiting to congratulate you.
